answer_1.quote: This paper presents a principled approach to enhance caption quality and develops a parameter-efficient captioner capable of scaling re-captioning efforts.
answer_1.outputs: dense captions with concrete visual concepts, improved alignment between image and text

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU/METEOR/ROUGE/CIDEr metrics and noun phrase (NP) precision, recall and F1 score.

answer_4.quote: We further conduct human evaluation by presenting the images, alt-texts and the captions produced by various models, and asking evaluators about three criteria
answer_4.guideline: Whether the caption (i) is aligned with the image & has fewer hallucinations; (ii) is specific (named entities, detailed description); (iii) carries useful information from the alt-text.
criteria: carries useful information from the alt-text
